MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Ember Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5 T or 3.0 T
· Gradient slew rate ≤ 100 T/m/s (per axis)
· Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.5 W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
· Device configuration: Therapy OFF
· Scan regions: Exclusion zone: do not position the isocenter between the C7 vertebra and the iliac crest
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Ember Neuromodulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
